operation.query_signature: $$Y_t^+=f(z_t^+)+\varepsilon_t^+,\qquad Y_t^-=f(z_t^-)+\varepsilon_t^-,\qquad \varepsilon_t^\pm\overset{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2).$$ The center $x_t$ and both probes $z_t^+,z_t^-$ must be submitted together before either observation is received. Noise is independent across all queries, with no shared seed. Only the center loss $f(x_t)$ is incurred; probe values are information queries and do not enter that round's loss. Causal policies may submit two simultaneous probes per round. Inputs $d,T,R,L,\sigma$ are public and $f$ is hidden. Both probes and the center must lie in the same ball. Past feedback may be stored and reused computationally; unrevealed past information and additional queries to exhausted samples are unavailable. Any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

protocols.adversary_information: Follow the model and oracle timing. Current private random realizations are not visible to the environment.
protocols.loss_bearing_points: The output is the complete action trajectory satisfying feasibility and timing requirements. Randomized mixtures may be implemented before acting. Retrospective averages or convex combinations cannot replace actions that have already incurred loss. No additional optimal value or certificate is required.
protocols.past_requery: History may be stored. New information from old samples or past rounds is unavailable unless the native interface explicitly permits it.
steps: The center $x_t$ and both probes $z_t^+,z_t^-$ must be submitted together before any response is received. Noise is independent across every query, with no shared random seed.
Only the center loss $f(x_t)$ is incurred each round. The two probes provide information, and their values are not added to the round loss.
Causal policies may submit two simultaneous probes per round. The quantities $d,T,R,L,\sigma$ are public; $f$ is hidden. Both probes and their center must lie in the same ball.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.

variable_blocks.dimension: A d-dimensional center and two probes with 2d coordinates, all chosen simultaneously.
variable_blocks.space: The center satisfies $x_t\in B_2^d(R)$, and both probes satisfy $z_t^+,z_t^-\in B_2^d(R)$.
